identification: Unbranded Chinese 'S25 Ultra' look-alike Android smartphone (clone/replica of the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra), new in a plain black box printed only with a phone-and-stylus picture. Screen shows the generic orange 'welcome' boot logo used by clone makers (a genuine Samsung boots with the SAMSUNG Galaxy logo), then a stock-AOSP lock screen (big stacked clock 21:48, 'Tue, Nov 24', 'No SIM card', 87% battery), not Samsung One UI. Centred punch-hole and rounded corners; protective film on. Not a genuine Galaxy S25 Ultra (which retails about A$2,000+).
